<insights>
- U.S. Route 23 runs north-south between Jacksonville, Florida, and Mackinaw City, Michigan.
- Clay Township is located on U.S. Route 23, four miles north of the Portsmouth, Ohio, city limits.
- The Mid-South Conference has nine full members, including Cumberland (TN) and Cumberlands (KY).
</insights>

<answer>
U.S. Route 23 is the north-south US highway that goes through Clay Township and also through the Mid-South Conference former affiliate member city Cumberland (TN).
</answer>

<subanswer>
- Cumberland (TN) is a city that is part of the Mid-South Conference and has a statue of an angel.
</subanswer>
